ID: ARGCRT1				
Country: Argentina				
City: Corrientes				
Period: April 1873- December 1888				
Resolution: Monthly				
Observers: The first observer was the rector of the school Santiago Fitz-Simon and later his brother Eduardo Fitz-Simon.				
Location Observatory: -27.46, -58.83 (77 masl) (Colegio Nacional)				
Meteorological variables: Mean temperature (Column 3); Mean Barometer (Column 4); Precipitation (Column 5).				
Data source: Davis, Gualterio G. 1889. Ligeros apuntes sobre el clima de la República Argentina. Por el Director de la Oficina Meteorológica  Argentina.  Imprenta de Pablo E. Coni e Hijos Buenos Aires.				
Descriptive Name: Corrientes_1873_1887				
Other comments: The thermometers were under the roof of an open room oriented to the south and protected from the sun by a corridor. Celsius is the most probable unit of the temperature record. Milimeter is the most probable unit ofthe barometer and precipitation record.
